pairs: Anno vigesimo septimo Jeroboam regis Israël,
In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam, the king of Israel:
regnavit Azarias filius Amasiæ regis Juda.
Azariah, the son of Amaziah, reigned as king of Judah.
Sedecim annorum erat cum regnare cœpisset,
He was sixteen years old when he had begun to reign,
et quinquaginta duobus annis regnavit in Jerusalem:
and he reigned for fifty-two years in Jerusalem.
nomen matris ejus Jechelia de Jerusalem.
The name of his mother was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
Fecitque quod erat placitum coram Domino,
And he did what was pleasing before the Lord,
juxta omnia quæ fecit Amasias pater ejus.
in accord with all that his father, Amaziah, did.
Verumtamen excelsa non est demolitus:
Yet truly, he did not demolish the high places.
adhuc populus sacrificabat,
And still the people were sacrificing,
et adolebat incensum in excelsis.
and burning incense, in the high places.
Percussit autem Dominus regem,
Now the Lord struck the king,
et fuit leprosus usque in diem mortis suæ,
and he became a leper, even until the day of his death.
et habitabat in domo libera seorsum:
And he was living in a separate house by himself. And truly,
Joatham vero filius regis gubernabat palatium,
Jotham, the son of the king, governed the palace,
et judicabit populum terræ.
and he judged the people of the land.
Reliqua autem sermonum Azariæ,
Now the rest of the words of Azariah,
et universa quæ fecit,
and all that he did,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Juda?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
Et dormivit Azarias cum patribus suis:
And Azariah slept with his fathers,
sepelieruntque eum cum majoribus suis in civitate David,
and they buried him with his ancestors in the city of David.
et regnavit Joatham filius ejus pro eo.
And Jotham, his son, reigned in his place.
Anno trigesimo octavo Azariæ regis Juda, regnavit Zacharias filius Jeroboam super Israël in Samaria sex mensibus.
In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah, the king of Judah: Zechariah, the son of Jeroboam, reigned over Israel, in Samaria, for six months.
Et fecit quod malum est coram Domino,
And he did what is evil before the Lord,
sicut fecerant patres ejus:
just as his fathers had done.
non recessit a peccatis Jeroboam filii Nabat,
He did not withdraw from the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat,
qui peccare fecit Israël.
who caused Israel to sin.
Conjuravit autem contra eum Sellum filius Jabes:
Then Shallum, the son of Jabesh, conspired against him.
percussitque eum palam,
And he struck him openly,
et interfecit,
and killed him.
regnavitque pro eo.
And he reigned in his place.
Reliqua autem verborum Zachariæ,
Now the rest of the words of Zechariah,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
Iste est sermo Domini quem locutus est ad Jehu,
This was the word of the Lord, which he spoke to Jehu,
dicens:
saying:
Filii tui usque ad quartam generationem sedebunt super thronum Israël.
“Your sons, even to the fourth generation, shall sit upon the throne of Israel.”
Factumque est ita.
And so it happened.
Sellum filius Jabes regnavit trigesimo novo anno Azariæ regis Juda: regnavit autem uno mense in Samaria.
Shallum, the son of Jabesh, reigned in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah, the king of Judah. And he reigned for one month, in Samaria.
Et ascendit Manahem filius Gadi de Thersa,
And Menahem, the son of Gadi, ascended from Tirzah.
venitque in Samariam,
And he went into Samaria,
et percussit Sellum filium Jabes in Samaria,
and he struck Shallum, the son of Jabesh, in Samaria.
et interfecit eum:
And he killed him,
regnavitque pro eo.
and reigned in his place.
Reliqua autem verborum Sellum,
Now the rest of the words of Shallum,
et conjuratio ejus,
and his conspiracy,
per quam tetendit insidias,
by which he carried out treachery,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
Tunc percussit Manahem Thapsam,
Then Menahem struck Tirzah,
et omnes qui erant in ea,
and all who were in it,
et terminos ejus de Thersa:
and its borders around Tirzah.
noluerant enim aperire ei:
For they were not willing to open to him.
et interfecit omnes prægnantes ejus,
And he killed all of its pregnant women,
et scidit eas.
and he tore them open.
Anno trigesimo nono Azariæ regis Juda, regnavit Manahem filius Gadi super Israël decem annis in Samaria.
In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah, the king of Judah: Menahem, son of Gadi, reigned over Israel for ten years, in Samaria.
Fecitque quod erat malum coram Domino:
And he did what was evil before the Lord.
non recessit a peccatis Jeroboam filii Nabat,
He did not withdraw from the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat,
qui peccare fecit Israël,
who caused Israel to sin,
cunctis diebus ejus.
during all his days.
Veniebat Phul rex Assyriorum in terram,
Then Pul, the king of the Assyrians, came into the land.
et dabat Manahem Phul mille talenta argenti,
And Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver,
ut esset ei in auxilium,
so that he would be a help to him,
et firmaret regnum ejus.
and so that he might strengthen his kingdom.
Indixitque Manahem argentum super Israël cunctis potentibus
And Menahem proclaimed a tax upon Israel,
et divitibus,
on all who were powerful and wealthy,
ut daret regi Assyriorum quinquaginta siclos argenti per singulos:
so that each one would give to the king of the Assyrians fifty shekels of silver.
reversusque est rex Assyriorum,
Then the king of the Assyrians turned back,
et non est moratus in terra.
and he did not remain in the land.
Reliqua autem sermonum Manahem,
Now the rest of the words of Menahem,
et universa quæ fecit,
and all that he did,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
Et dormivit Manahem cum patribus suis:
And Menahem slept with his fathers.
regnavitque Phaceia filius ejus pro eo.
And Pekahiah, his son, reigned in his place.
Anno quinquagesimo Azariæ regis Juda, regnavit Phaceia filius Manahem super Israël in Samaria biennio.
In the fiftieth year of Azariah, the king of Judah: Pekahiah, the son of Menahem, reigned over Israel, in Samaria, for two years.
Et fecit quod erat malum coram Domino:
And he did what was evil before the Lord.
non recessit a peccatis Jeroboam filii Nabat,
He did not withdraw from the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat,
qui peccare fecit Israël.
who caused Israel to sin.
Conjuravit autem adversus eum Phacee filius Romeliæ,
Then Pekah, the son of Remaliah, his commander,
dux ejus, et percussit eum in Samaria in turre domus regiæ,
conspired against him. And he struck him in Samaria,
juxta Argob et juxta Arie,
in the tower of the king’s house,
et cum eo quinquaginta viros de filiis Galaaditarum:
near Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men from the sons of the Gileadites.
et interfecit eum,
And he killed him,
regnavitque pro eo.
and reigned in his place.
Reliqua autem sermonum Phaceia,
Now the rest of the words of Pekahiah,
et universa quæ fecit,
and all that he did,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
Anno quinquagesimo secundo Azariæ regis Juda, regnavit Phacee filius Romeliæ super Israël in Samaria viginti annis.
In the fifty-second year of Azariah, the king of Judah: Pekah, the son of Remaliah, reigned over Israel, in Samaria, for twenty years.
Et fecit quod erat malum coram Domino:
And he did what was evil before the Lord.
non recessit a peccatis Jeroboam filii Nabat,
He did not withdraw from the sins of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat,
qui peccare fecit Israël.
who caused Israel to sin.
In diebus Phacee regis Israël,
In the days of Pekah, the king of Israel,
venit Theglathphalasar rex Assur,
Tiglath-pileser, the king of Assyria,
et cepit Ajon,
arrived and captured Ijon,
et Abel Domum, Maacha et Janoë,
and Abel Bethmaacah, and Janoah,
et Cedes,
and Kedesh,
et Asor,
and Hazor,
et Galaad,
and Gilead,
et Galilæam,
and Galilee,
et universam terram Nephthali:
and the entire land of Naphtali.
et transtulit eos in Assyrios.
And he took them away into Assyria.
Conjuravit autem et tetendit insidias Osee filius Ela contra Phacee filium Romeliæ,
Then Hoshea, the son of Elah, conspired and carried out treachery against Pekah,
et percussit eum,
the son of Remaliah.
et interfecit:
And he struck him, and killed him.
regnavitque pro eo vigesimo anno Joatham filii Oziæ.
And he reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham, the son of Uzziah.
Reliqua autem sermonum Phacee,
Now the rest of the words of Pekah,
et universa quæ fecit,
and all that he did,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel?
Anno secundo Phacee filii Romeliæ regis Israël,
In the second year of Pekah, the son of Remaliah, the king of Israel:
regnavit Joatham filius Oziæ regis Juda.
Jotham, son of Uzziah, reigned as king of Judah.
Viginti quinque annorum erat cum regnare cœpisset,
He was twenty-five years old when he had begun to reign,
et sedecim annis regnavit in Jerusalem:
and he reigned for sixteen years in Jerusalem.
nomen matris ejus Jerusa filia Sadoc.
The name of his mother was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
Fecitque quod erat placitum coram Domino:
And he did what was pleasing before the Lord.
juxta omnia quæ fecerat Ozias pater suus,
In accord with all that his father, Uzziah,
operatus est.
had done, so he did.
Verumtamen excelsa non abstulit:
Yet truly, he did not take away the high places.
adhuc populus immolabat,
And still the people were immolating,
et adolebat incensum in excelsis.
and burning incense, in the high places.
Ipse ædificavit portam domus Domini sublimissimam.
But he edified the gate of the house of the Lord to be very sublime.
Reliqua autem sermonum Joatham,
Now the rest of the words of Jotham,
et universa quæ fecit,
and all that he did,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Juda?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
In diebus illis cœpit Dominus mittere in Judam Rasin regem Syriæ, et Phacee filium Romeliæ.
In those days, the Lord began to send, into Judah, Rezin, the king of Syria, and Pekah, the son of Remaliah.
Et dormivit Joatham cum patribus suis,
And Jotham slept with his fathers,
sepultusque est cum eis in civitate David patris sui:
and he was buried with them in the city of David, his father.
et regnavit Achaz filius ejus pro eo.
And Ahaz, his son, reigned in his place.
